21: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ. ਸੰਕ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
The state of the inner being is known by meeting the Guru, casting off all doubt.
ਮੁਇਆ. ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ; ਤਿਤੁ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
The home you must go to after death — die to yourself while still alive, (conquering the fear of death).
ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ; ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
It is attained through the beautiful, unceasing Word, by reflecting on the Guru's teaching. ॥2॥
ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਤਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
When the unceasing Bani is attained, ego is destroyed.
ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ; ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
Whoever serves his True Guru — I am forever a sacrifice to him.
ਖੜਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਈਐ; ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
He is taken into the Lord's court and robed in honour; the Lord's Name dwells on his lips. ॥3॥
ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ. ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ; ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
Wherever I look, I see the union of soul and Maya (pervading).
ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੰਧੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ; ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਿ. ਸੋ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
The body is bound by the three qualities; whoever comes into the world plays this game.
ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ. ਲਹਹਿ ਨ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੪॥
Separated, they suffer in pain; the self-willed do not attain union. ॥4॥
ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸਚ ਭੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
The detached mind dwells in its own home, imbued with the fear of the True One.
ਗਿਆਨ ਮਹਾਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਵੈ; ਬਾਹੁੜਿ. ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
It enjoys the supreme essence of spiritual wisdom, and does not hunger again.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੁ; ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ. ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੮॥
O Nanak, subdue this mind and meet Him; then you shall not suffer pain again. ॥5॥18॥
ਏਹੁ ਮਨੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ; ਲੋਭੇ ਲਗਾ ਲੋੁਭਾਨੁ ॥
This foolish mind is greedy; clinging to greed, it is ever more greedy.
ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ. ਸਾਕਤਾ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
The faithless one is not softened by the Word; through evil-mindedness he keeps coming and going.
ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
If the holy True Guru is met, then the treasure of virtues is found. ॥1॥
O mind, give up ego and conceit.
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂ; ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Serve the Lord-Guru, the pool of nectar, and you shall be honoured in His court. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Chant the Lord's Name day and night; through the Guru, know the Lord's wealth.
ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣੇ; ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
All comforts and the Lord's sublime essence are enjoyed by gaining wisdom in the society of saints.
ਨਿਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
Those to whom the True Guru gave the Name serve the Lord God day and night. ॥2॥
ਕੂਕਰ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰ. ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਨੁ ॥
The self-willed practise falsehood like dogs; slandering the Guru, they burn and rot away.
ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ. ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ; ਜਮੁ. ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਖੁਲਹਾਨੁ ॥
Deluded by doubt, they suffer great pain; Death beats them and threshes them like grain.
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਭਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
The self-willed find no peace; the Guru-facing find wondrous peace. ॥3॥
ਐਥੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟਾਈਐ; ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
Here one is tangled in worldly affairs; there only the true account is accepted.
ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦਾ; ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
The Guru serves the Lord, the true Friend; the Guru's deeds are supreme.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਕਰਮਿ ਸਚੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੧੯॥
O Nanak, one who bears the mark of the True One's grace never forgets the Name. ॥4॥19॥
ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
If the Beloved is forgotten even for an instant, a great disease arises in the mind.
ਕਿਉ. ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਾ ਹਰਿ. ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
How can honour be gained in His court if the Lord does not dwell in the mind?
ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Meeting the Guru, peace is found; the fire is put out in His praises. ॥1॥
ਮਨ ਰੇ; ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
O mind, dwell upon the Lord's virtues day and night.
ਜਿਨ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ; ਤੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Rare in this world are those who do not forget the Name for even a moment. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ; ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
When one's light merges with His Light, and one's awareness is joined with His,
ਹਿੰਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਤੁ ਗਏ; ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
cruelty and ego depart, and no doubt or sorrow remains.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
The Guru-facing one in whose mind the Lord dwells — the Guru unites him in union. ॥2॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ; ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
If I make my body a bride (devoted to Him), the Enjoyer enjoys her.
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ. ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ; ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
Do not fall in love with what is plainly passing away.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
The Guru-facing happy brides enjoy God, the Husband, on the bed of the heart. ॥3॥
22: ਚਾਰੇ ਅਗਨਿ. ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਮਰੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
Through the Guru pour the Lord's water on the four fires, and die (to craving).
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
The lotus within blossoms, filled to satisfaction with Amrit.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰਿ; ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੦॥
O Nanak, make the True Guru your friend; going to His court, you shall find the True One. ॥4॥20॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
Chant the Lord's Name, my dear; following the Guru's teaching, speak of the Lord.
ਮਨੁ. ਸਚ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਈਐ; ਤੁਲੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
Put the mind to the touchstone of truth, and see that it weighs full weight.
ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਰਿਦ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥
No one can find the worth of the jewel of the heart; its value is priceless. ॥1॥
ਭਾਈ ਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ. ਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
O brother, the Lord's diamond is with the Guru.
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In the true congregation the True Guru is found; praise Him through the Word day and night. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਲੈ; ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
Gather the true merchandise, wealth and capital; it is found through the Guru's light.
ਜਿਉ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ. ਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਐ; ਤਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ. ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਿ ॥
As fire is put out by pouring water, so craving is quenched by becoming the slave of His slaves.
ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ. ਨ ਲਗਈ; ਇਉ. ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ. ਤਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
The fearsome Messenger of Death will not touch you; thus you shall cross the terrifying world-ocean and carry others across. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ; ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚ ਭਾਇ ॥
The Guru-facing do not like falsehood; they are imbued with truth and the love of the True One.
ਸਾਕਤ. ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ; ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਂਇ ॥
The faithless do not like truth; false is the honour of the false.
ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਐ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
Imbued with truth, united by the Guru, they merge in the Truest of the true. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ. ਲਾਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
Within the mind is the Name — the ruby, the gem, the jewel, the precious diamond.
ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
The Name is the true merchandise and wealth; the deep, unfathomable Lord is in every heart.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥
O Nanak, through the Guru it is found, when the Lord, the Diamond, shows His mercy. ॥4॥21॥
ਭਰਮੇ. ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਵਿਝਵੈ; ਜੇ ਭਵੈ. ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
Wandering about does not put out the fire, even if one roams land after land.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ. ਨ ਉਤਰੈ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
The filth within is not removed; cursed is such a life, cursed such garb.
ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਤੈ. ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਬਿਨੁ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥੧॥
There is no devotion anywhere else without the True Guru's teaching. ॥1॥
O mind, through the Guru, put out the fire.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Let the Guru's word dwell in your mind; ego and craving shall die. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
The mind is a priceless jewel; through the Lord's Name it gains honour.
ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ. ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Joining the true congregation the Lord is found; through the Guru one is lovingly attuned to Him.
ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
Self-conceit departs and peace is found, as water mingles and merges with water. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ; ਸੁ. ਅਉਗੁਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
One who has not remembered the Lord's Name keeps coming and going because of his faults.
ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ. ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ; ਸੁ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
One who has not met the True Guru, the Primal Being, rots away in the terrifying world-ocean.
ਇਹੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ; ਇਉ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
This soul is a priceless jewel, yet it is squandered thus for a mere shell. ॥3॥
ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਣ ॥
Those who meet the True Guru with love are complete and wise.
ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ; ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Meeting the Guru, the terrifying world-ocean is crossed, and one is honoured and accepted in His court.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ; ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨੨॥
O Nanak, radiant are their faces; within them the music of the Word wells up as their insignia. ॥4॥22॥
ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਹੋ; ਵਖਰੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
Do your trading, O traders, and take care of your merchandise.
ਤੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੀਐ; ਜੈਸੀ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Buy such goods as will stay with you to the end.
ਅਗੈ. ਸਾਹੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ; ਲੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
In the world beyond, the Merchant is wise; He will check the goods and accept them. ॥1॥
ਭਾਈ ਰੇ; ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
O brother, chant the Lord's Name with your consciousness fixed on Him.
ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਲਹੁ; ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Take the merchandise of the Lord's praise with you; the Husband will see it and be pleased. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
23: ਜਿਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ; ਕਿਉ. ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Those who do not have the capital of truth — how can they find peace?
ਖੋਟੈ ਵਣਜਿ ਵਣੰਜਿਐ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਟਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Dealing in counterfeit trade, mind and body become counterfeit.
ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ; ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਨਿਤ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
Like a deer caught in a trap, they suffer great pain and weep constantly. ॥2॥
ਖੋਟੇ. ਪੋਤੈ ਨਾ ਪਵਹਿ; ਤਿਨ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ, ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Counterfeit coins are not put into the treasury; such people do not see the Lord-Guru.
ਖੋਟੇ. ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ; ਖੋਟਿ. ਨ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
The counterfeit have no status and no honour; no one succeeds through falsehood.
ਖੋਟੇ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ; ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
The counterfeit practise only falsehood; they come and go and lose their honour. ॥3॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
O Nanak, instruct the mind through the Guru's Word, by praising the Lord.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ; ਭਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਰਮੁ. ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥
Those imbued with love for the Lord's Name carry no load of sin and no doubt.
ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਅਗਲਾ; ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੪॥੨੩॥
Chanting the Lord's Name the profit is great; the Fearless Lord dwells in the mind. ॥4॥23॥
ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਫੁਲੜਾ; ਨਾਠੀਅੜੇ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
Wealth, youth and a little flower are guests for just four days.
ਪਬਣਿ ਕੇਰੇ. ਪਤ ਜਿਉ; ਢਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਜੁੰਮਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
Like the leaves of the water-lily, they wither, fade and die. ॥1॥
ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਜਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਨਉ ਹੁਲਾ ॥
Enjoy His love, my dear, while youth is fresh and new.
ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਥਕੇ; ਭਇਆ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਚੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Your days are few, and you have grown weary; the robe of the body has grown old. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਜਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ; ਜਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਣਿ ॥
My playful friends have gone to sleep in the graveyard.
ਹੰ ਭੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਡੁਮਣੀ; ਰੋਵਾ ਝੀਣੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
I too shall go, uneasy in mind; I weep in a feeble voice. ॥2॥
ਕੀ. ਨ ਸੁਣੇਹੀ ਗੋਰੀਏ; ਆਪਣ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
O fair bride, why do you not listen to this news with your own ears?
ਲਗੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ; ਨਿਤ. ਨ ਪੇਈਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
You must go to your in-laws' home (the world beyond); you shall not stay in your parents' home (this world) forever. ॥3॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਤੀ ਪੇਈਐ; ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਰਤੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥
O Nanak, the bride who sleeps in her parents' home is robbed in broad daylight.
ਗੁਣਾ ਗਵਾਈ ਗੰਠੜੀ; ਅਵਗਣ ਚਲੀ ਬੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੨੪॥
She has lost her bundle of virtues, and departs with a load of faults tied up. ॥4॥24॥
ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ. ਆਪਿ ਰਸੁ; ਆਪੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
He Himself is the Enjoyer, He Himself the taste, He Himself the One who delights in it.
ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ; ਆਪੇ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
He Himself is the bride, He Himself the bed and the Husband. ॥1॥
ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My Master is imbued with love; He pervades and fills everything completely. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪੇ ਮਾਛੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ; ਆਪੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
He Himself is the fisherman and the fish, He Himself the water and the net.
ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲ ਮਣਕੜਾ; ਆਪੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
He Himself is the net's weights, and He Himself the bait within. ॥2॥
ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ; ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
My Beloved Himself is playful in so many ways, O my companion.
ਨਿਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਦੇਖੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੩॥
He constantly enjoys the happy brides; but look at my state! ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ. ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
Nanak offers this prayer: you are the lake, and you are the swan.
ਕਉਲੁ ਤੂ ਹੈ. ਕਵੀਆ ਤੂ ਹੈ; ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥
You are the lotus and the night-lily; you Yourself behold them and rejoice. ॥4॥25॥
ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ. ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਰੋ; ਸਲਿਲ ਆਪਾਉ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
Make this body the field and your deeds the seed; irrigate it with the water of the Name of the Lord of the world.
ਮਨੁ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ. ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ; ਇਉ ਪਾਵਸਿ. ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Let your mind be the farmer, and make the Lord sprout in your heart; thus you shall attain the state free of desire. ॥1॥
You fool, why are you so proud of Maya?
ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤੋ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਤਾ; ਤੇਰੇ. ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Father, sons, wife, mother — none of them shall be your helpers in the end. ॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੁਸਟ. ਕਿਰਖਾ ਕਰੇ; ਇਨ ਤਜਿ. ਆਤਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
One who weeds out evil and corruption from the field, and, giving them up, meditates within with a focused mind —
ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ. ਹੋਹਿ ਜਬ ਰਾਖੇ; ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ. ਮਧੁ ਆਸ੍ਰਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
when chanting, austerity and self-discipline become his guardians, the lotus blossoms and the honey trickles forth. ॥2॥
ਬੀਸ ਸਪਤਾਹਰੋ. ਬਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ; ਤੀਨਿ ਖੋੜਾ. ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਾਰੈ ॥
One who gathers the Name every day under all twenty-seven lunar mansions, and remembers death through the three stages of life,
ਦਸ ਅਠਾਰ ਮੈ. ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਚੀਨੈ; ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਇਵ ਏਕੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨੬॥
who seeks the Infinite in the ten and eighteen (Vedas, Shastras and Puranas) — says Nanak, the One Lord carries such a one across. ॥3॥26॥
24: ਅਮਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਤੀ. ਬੀਜੁ ਸਬਦੋ ਕਰਿ; ਸਚ ਕੀ ਆਬ. ਨਿਤ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Make good deeds the soil and the Word the seed; irrigate it constantly with the water of truth.
ਹੋਇ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ. ਈਮਾਨੁ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ; ਭਿਸਤੁ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਮੂੜੇ. ਏਵ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
Become such a farmer, and faith will sprout; this, you fool, is how you shall know heaven and hell. ॥1॥
Do not think that the Lord is found by mere talk.
ਮਾਲ ਕੈ ਮਾਣੈ. ਰੂਪ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਇਤੁ ਬਿਧੀ. ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In the pride of wealth and the splendour of beauty, life has been wasted in this way. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਐਬ ਤਨਿ ਚਿਕੜੋ. ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੀਡਕੋ; ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ, ਨਹੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
The body is mud full of sins, and this mind is a frog; it has no appreciation of the lotus at all.
ਭਉਰੁ ਉਸਤਾਦੁ. ਨਿਤ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਬੋਲੇ; ਕਿਉ ਬੂਝੈ. ਜਾ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥
The bumblebee is the teacher who constantly speaks the lesson; but how can one understand unless He gives understanding? ॥2॥
ਆਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ. ਪਉਣ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
Speaking and listening are like the sound of the wind, while this mind is dyed in Maya.
ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ. ਦਿਲਹਿ ਪਸਿੰਦੇ; ਜਿਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
The Master's glance of grace is on those dear to His heart, who meditate on Him as the One. ॥3॥
ਤੀਹ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ, ਪੰਜ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਥੀ; ਨਾਉ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ. ਮਤੁ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
You keep the thirty fasts and make the five prayers your companions, lest you be called a devil.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ. ਰਾਹਿ ਪੈ ਚਲਣਾ; ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ. ਕਿਤ ਕੂ ਸੰਜਿਆਹੀ ॥੪॥੨੭॥
Nanak says, you must walk the true path; why do you hoard wealth and possessions? ॥4॥27॥
ਸੋਈ ਮਉਲਾ. ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ; ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
He alone is the Master who made the world blossom and made the universe green.
ਆਬ ਖਾਕੁ. ਜਿਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਹਾਈ; ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
Blessed is the Creator, who holds water and earth bound together. ॥1॥
Death, O Mullah — death will come.
So live in the fear of the Creator. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੁਲਾ, ਤਾ ਤੂ ਕਾਜੀ; ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥
You are a Mullah, you are a Qazi, only when you know the Name of God.
ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ. ਪੜਿਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ; ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਨ. ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
However much you may have studied, no one can remain when the measure of life is full. ॥2॥
ਸੋਈ ਕਾਜੀ. ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਤਜਿਆ; ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
He alone is a Qazi who has given up self-conceit and made the One Name his support.
ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ. ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ; ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
The True Creator is, and shall be; He was not born and shall not die. ॥3॥
ਪੰਜ ਵਖਤ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਹਿ; ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
You may say your prayers five times a day, and read the Bible and the Qur'an —
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ. ਗੋਰ ਸਦੇਈ; ਰਹਿਓ ਪੀਣਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥
Nanak says, when the grave calls, your eating and drinking are over. ॥4॥28॥
A dog (greed) and two bitches (hope and craving) are with me;
they bark from early morning, all the time.
Falsehood is my dagger; deceived (by Maya), I eat carrion (what is not mine).
I live like a wild hunter, O Creator. ॥1॥
ਮੈ. ਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਪੰਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
I have followed neither your counsel, O Lord of honour, nor done good deeds.
Your one Name carries the world across.
ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਆਸ; ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This is my only hope, my only support. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
With my mouth I speak slander, day and night.
I peep into others' homes; I am lowly and base.
Lust and anger, the outcastes, dwell in my body.
I live like a wild hunter, O Creator. ॥2॥
My mind is on setting snares, while I wear the garb of a holy man.
I am a den of thieves, cheating the whole land.
The cleverer I become, the heavier my load (of sin).
I live like a wild hunter, O Creator. ॥3॥
I have not appreciated what you have done for me; I take what is not mine.
ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਾ; ਦੁਸਟੁ ਚੋਰੁ ॥
What face shall I show you? I am a wicked thief.
I live like a wild hunter, O Creator. ॥4॥29॥
There is one awareness in all beings.
25: As is the understanding (He gives), so is the path they take.
By the One's own decree they come and go. ॥1॥
O soul, why do you try to be so clever?
ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਵੈ; ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He gives and takes away without delay. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All beings are yours; you are the Master of all beings.
Why should you, O Master, become angry?
Even if you, O Master, were to become angry,
you are theirs, and they are yours. ॥2॥
We speak badly, spoiling our words,
yet you weigh us with your glance of grace.
Where there are good deeds, there is perfect understanding.
Without good deeds, understanding sinks lower and lower. ॥3॥
Prays Nanak: what is the truly wise person like?
He recognises his own self, and understands the Lord.
By the Guru's grace he reflects on Him.
Such a wise one is accepted in the Lord's court. ॥4॥30॥
ਤੂ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ; ਮੈ ਮਛੁਲੀ. ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਲਹਾ ॥
You are the river, all-knowing and all-seeing; I am a little fish — how can I find your limit?
ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ, ਤਹ ਤਹ ਤੂ ਹੈ; ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸੀ. ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰਾ ॥੧॥
Wherever I look, there you are; taken out of you, I burst and die. ॥1॥
ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਉ; ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
I know nothing of the fisherman, nor of his net.
ਜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When pain strikes, I remember you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
You are all-pervading, yet I thought you were far away.
ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੀ; ਸੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
Whatever I do, I do in your presence.
You see everything, yet I deny what I have done.
I do not engage in your work, nor in your Name. ॥2॥
Whatever you give me, that is what I eat.
ਬਿਆ ਦਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
There is no other door; to which door should I go?
this soul and body are all in your hands. ॥3॥
ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ, ਦੂਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ; ਆਪੇ ਮੰਝਿ ਮਿਆਨੋੁ ॥
He Himself is near, He Himself is far away, He Himself is in between.
ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ. ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨੋੁ ॥
He Himself sees and He Himself hears; by His creative power He made the world.
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਨੋੁ ॥੪॥੩੧॥
Whatever pleases Him, O Nanak — that command is accepted. ॥4॥31॥
What pride can the created being take in his mind?
The gifts are in the hands of the Giver.
As He pleases, He gives or does not give.
What can happen by the word of the created one? ॥1॥
He Himself is True; Truth is pleasing to Him.
The spiritually blind one is shallow, utterly shallow. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The One to whom the trees and plants belong gives them their adornment.
As is their nature, so are they named (and so is their fruit).
As is the flower of one's inner feeling, so is the fruit one receives, as written.
One eats what one has sown oneself. ॥2॥
The wall is weak, and weak is the mason within (the immature mind).
The intellect is unsalted, and the taste is insipid.
O Nanak, only if He sets it right is it set right.
Without the Name, there is no applause. ॥3॥32॥
ਅਛਲ ਛਲਾਈ. ਨਹ ਛਲੈ; ਨਹ ਘਾਉ ਕਟਾਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ॥
Maya the deceiver cannot herself be deceived; no dagger can wound her.
ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਾਖੈ. ਤਿਉ ਰਹੈ; ਇਸੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ, ਟਲ ਪਲੈ ॥੧॥
As the Master keeps one, so one remains; the soul of this greedy one wavers this way and that. ॥1॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਤੇਲ; ਦੀਵਾ ਕਿਉ ਜਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without oil, how can the lamp burn? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Let living by the holy books be the oil,
put the wick of the fear of God into this body,
and light it with the understanding of truth. ॥2॥
Use this oil, and the lamp burns thus.
ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ; ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤਉ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Make this light, and you shall meet the Master. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When the Guru's word takes effect in this body,
peace comes through performing His service,
26: and the whole world is seen to be coming and going. ॥3॥
In the midst of the world, perform His service;
then you shall be given a seat in His court.
Says Nanak, then you may swing your arms in joy, free of care. ॥4॥33॥

One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਉ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਆਪਣਾ; ਇਕ ਮਨਿ. ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
I serve my True Guru with a one-pointed mind and focused consciousness, with love.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
The True Guru is the shrine that fulfils the mind's desires — for the one whom He makes understand.
ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਾ; ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
The blessings the mind longs for are obtained; whatever one wishes, that fruit one receives.
ਨਾਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਗੀਐ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Meditate on the Name, ask for the Name; through the Name one merges in poise. ॥1॥
ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ, ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ; ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
O my mind, taste the Lord's sublime essence, and your thirst shall depart.
ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who have tasted it through the Guru remain merged in poise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Those who serve the True Guru obtain the treasure of the Name.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ. ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
The Lord's sublime essence pervades them within, and pride is gone from their minds.
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ; ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
The lotus of the heart blossoms, and they are attuned in poise.
ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਪਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
Their pure minds dwell on the Lord, and they are honoured in His court. ॥2॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ; ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
Rare in this world are those who serve their True Guru,

The perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name in them; the devotees hold an inexhaustible treasure. ॥1॥
ਭਾਈ ਰੇ; ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
ਏ ਮਨ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O mind, why are you so lazy? Through the Guru, meditate on the Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹੈ; ਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Devotion to the Lord is love for the Lord, if one reflects through the Guru.
ਪਾਖੰਡਿ. ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬੋਲੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Hypocrisy does not bring devotion; words spoken in duality bring only ruin.
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
That person in whom there is discerning wisdom does not mix in (with the hypocrites), even if made to. ॥2॥
ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ. ਹਰਿ ਆਖੀਐ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
He alone is called the Lord's servant who keeps the Lord enshrined in his heart,
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ. ਆਗੈ ਧਰੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
who surrenders mind and body, placing them before Him, and subdues ego within.
ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Blessed and accepted is that Guru-facing one who never comes back defeated. ॥3॥
ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ; ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ. ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
By His grace He is found; without His grace He cannot be found.
29: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ. ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ॥
The 8.4 million species yearn for Him; only the one He unites comes to meet the Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਦਾ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੬॥੩੯॥
O Nanak, the Guru-facing one finds the Lord and remains forever merged in the Lord's Name. ॥4॥6॥39॥
ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
The Lord's Name is the ocean of peace; it is obtained through the Guru.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Meditate on the Name night and day, and you shall merge in the Name with ease.
ਅੰਦਰੁ ਰਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ; ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
The inner being is blended with the True Lord, and the tongue sings His praises. ॥1॥
ਭਾਈ ਰੇ; ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ. ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
O brother, the world suffers in the love of duality.
ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹਹਿ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In the Guru's sanctuary you shall find peace, meditating on the Name night and day. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਚੇ. ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ; ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
No filth sticks to the True One; meditating on the Lord, the mind becomes pure.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Through the Guru the Word is recognised, and one merges in the Lord's Amrit Name.
ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ; ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
When the blazing light of the Guru's wisdom is lit, the darkness of ignorance departs. ॥2॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ. ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
The self-willed are filthy, full of the filth of ego, craving and corruption.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ; ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
Without the Word the filth is not washed off; they die and are reborn, and are ruined.
ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ. ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹੇ; ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ. ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
They are entangled in this passing play, and find neither this shore nor the other. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੀ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
The Guru-facing are devoted to chanting, austerity and self-restraint, in love with the Lord's Name.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Through the Guru, meditate forever on the One Name of the Creator.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੦॥
O Nanak, meditate on the Name, the support of all beings. ॥4॥7॥40॥
ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ; ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
The self-willed are gripped by attachment; they have no longing for God and no detachment.
ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ. ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ. ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
They do not recognise the Word and suffer forever; they lose their honour in the Lord's court.
ਹਉਮੈ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਈਐ; ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Through the Guru ego is lost; imbued with the Name, one finds peace. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ॥
O my mind, day and night you are always full of hope (for Maya).
ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ, ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਲੈ; ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Serve the True Guru, and attachment is burnt away; you shall remain detached in your own home. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਗਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
The Guru-facing one does good deeds and blossoms, in love with the Lord and in bliss.
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਚੰਦੁ ॥
Day and night he performs devotional worship; subduing ego, he is free of care.
ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥੨॥
By great good fortune he has found the true congregation, and has found the Lord with natural bliss. ॥2॥
ਸੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋਈ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
He is the true holy one, the true renunciate, who enshrines the Name in his heart.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਮੂਲੇ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
Darkness does not touch him within at all; he has lost his self-conceit.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਅਘਾਏ ॥੩॥
The True Guru has shown him the treasure of the Name, and he drinks the Lord's essence to his fill. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤੀ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
Whoever has found Him has found Him in the company of the holy, by perfect destiny and loving detachment.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ; ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
The self-willed wander about, not knowing the True Guru, with ego clinging within.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ; ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ. ਕੇਹੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੧॥
O Nanak, those imbued with the Word are dyed in the Lord's Name; without the fear of God, how can the colour hold? ॥4॥8॥41॥
ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
The merchandise is found in one's own home; everything is within.
ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Remember the Name each and every moment; anyone who obtains it, obtains it through the Guru.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਹੈ; ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
The treasure of the Name is inexhaustible; it is obtained by great good fortune. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
O my mind, give up slander, ego and arrogance.
30: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru, meditate forever on the dear Lord, the One Creator. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
The faces of the Guru-facing are radiant, reflecting on the Guru's Word.
ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ; ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
They find peace here and hereafter, chanting the Lord's Name within their hearts.
ਘਰ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
Within their own home they find His mansion, reflecting on the Guru's Word. ॥2॥
ਸਤਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰਹਿ; ਮਥੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਲੇ ॥
Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru have their foreheads blackened.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ; ਨਿਤ ਜੋਹੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ॥
Night and day they earn only pain; they are ever watched and caught in the net of Death.
ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ. ਨ ਦੇਖਨੀ; ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਪਰਜਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
Even in dreams they find no peace; they are consumed by great anxiety. ॥3॥
ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
The One Lord is the Giver of all; He Himself bestows His grace.
ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਵਈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
Nothing can be said about it; He gives to whomever He pleases.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੪੨॥
O Nanak, He is found through the Guru; He Himself knows. ॥4॥9॥42॥
ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ; ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥
Serve the True Master, and the True One shall bless you with glory.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
By the Guru's grace He dwells in the mind, and ego is driven out.
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ. ਤਾ ਰਹੈ; ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
This wandering mind comes to rest only when He Himself casts His glance of grace. ॥1॥
ਭਾਈ ਰੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
O brother, through the Guru, meditate on the Lord's Name.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The treasure of the Name dwells forever in the mind, and one finds a place in His mansion. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਸ ਨਉ. ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
The mind and body of the self-willed are blind; he finds no place of rest.
ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਉਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ; ਜਿਉ. ਸੁੰਞੈਂ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥
He wanders through many births, like a crow in a deserted house.
ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ; ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
Through the Guru's teaching the heart is illumined; through the Word the Lord's Name is obtained. ॥2॥
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰ ॥
In the poison of the three qualities the world is blind, in the darkness of attachment to Maya.
ਲੋਭੀ ਅਨ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ; ਪੜਿ ਵੇਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
The greedy serve another, though they read the Vedas and proclaim them aloud.
ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ; ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ. ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
They rot to death in the poison, and find neither this shore nor the other. ॥3॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ; ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ॥
In attachment to Maya they have forgotten the Father of the world, the Cherisher.
ਬਾਝਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਬਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
Without the Guru all are unaware, held in bondage by the Messenger of Death.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਉਬਰੇ; ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੩॥
O Nanak, through the Guru's teaching they are saved, cherishing the True Name. ॥4॥10॥43॥
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਚਉਥਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
The three qualities hold the attachment to Maya; the Guru-facing one attains the fourth state.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਾਇਅਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
Granting His grace, He unites them with Himself, and the Lord's Name comes to dwell in the mind.
ਪੋਤੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਨ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
Those who have virtue as their treasure — He unites them with the true congregation. ॥1॥
O brother, follow the Guru's teaching and remain in the True One.
ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ; ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Practise truth and only truth, and be united with the True Word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to those who have recognised the Name.
ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਾ; ਚਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
Giving up self-conceit, I fall at their feet and walk in harmony with their will.
ਲਾਹਾ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
The profit of the Lord's Name is obtained, and one merges with ease in the Name. ॥2॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Without the Guru, His mansion is not found, and the Name is not obtained.
ਐਸਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ. ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ; ਜਿਦੂ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Seek and find such a True Guru, through whom that True Lord is found.
ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ. ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ; ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
Destroying the demons (of passion), one dwells in peace; whatever pleases Him comes to pass. ॥3॥
ਜੇਹਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ; ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
As one knows the True Guru to be, so is the peace one receives.
ਏਹੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ; ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
There is no doubt at all about this — let anyone love Him and see.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਰਤੀ; ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੪੪॥
O Nanak, one light, two forms: through the Word the union comes about. ॥4॥11॥44॥
